# UPchieve Changelog, week of Nov 7 to Nov 14, 2026

*Generated by Claude from merge-request and commit activity. Details may be inaccurate; check the linked MR or ask the author.*

Last deploys: high-line Nov 13, subway Nov 13. These deploys carried the My Coaches, session list, dashboard banner, DM reporting, scorecard, ESLint, and alert style work that last week's digest had as merged, approved, or in review.

**Status key:** 🚀 Launched (live to everyone) | 🧪 Experimental (in production, behind a feature flag) | 🎁 Merged (ships next deploy) | ✅ Approved (reviewed, not yet merged) | 👀 In review (needs review)

---

## My Coaches

Making the connections our power users make available to all users, earlier on. It runs through knowing your tutor, favorite coach presence, DMing a coach from one place instead of Session History, and in time things like asking for a specific coach.

- 🚀 **Measure My Coaches in PostHog:** a `DM_CONVERSATION_OPENED` event when the DM panel opens, and the coach's status (online, in session, or offline) on the request-coach event. ([high-line !2065](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2065)) *Alex Rodriguez*
- **Ask each student one impact question before and after their session:** 🚀 a `display` column on survey questions, so a question can say how it's drawn ([subway !3176](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3176)); 🚀 questions marked as a scale drawn as a row of 1 to 5 buttons, the rating design the construct questions use, working as a radio group for keyboards and screen readers ([high-line !2083](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2083)); 👀 one question per session on mattering, belonging, or confidence, the same item before and after, with the constructs shuffled across each student's sessions instead of asking every construct after the session ([subway !3170](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3170)); 👀 "How far do you expect to get in school?" before sessions, every 90 days instead of every session, to see whether students' college expectations change over time ([subway !3172](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3172)). We expect these to rise with the new relational features, and asking every construct after the session had made the form long, with completion rates halving around the same time. The scale questions come with the new survey versions in subway !3170. *Chris*
- **Give each coach-student pair one DM thread, apart from session recaps:** 🧪 a red dot on My Coaches or Messages in the sidebar and an orange one on the message button for an unread DM, with opening the chat marking it read ([high-line !2060](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2060)); 🧪 coaches' DM button only for students who can get DMs, grayed out with a tooltip otherwise ([high-line !2063](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2063)); 🧪 the Messages link in coaches' sidebar, hidden until DMs roll out ([high-line !2090](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2090)); 👀 an email when a new DM arrives, at most one an hour however many come in ([subway !3183](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3183)); 👀 session chat's "please be respectful" reminder under the DM chat box ([high-line !2097](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2097)); 👀 filters on My Coaches for favorite coaches (a chip now, not a toggle) and read or unread DMs ([high-line !2094](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2094)); 👀 filters on coaches' Messages page by student name and by read or unread DMs ([high-line !2095](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2095)). DMs are rolled out to no one yet ([`direct-messages`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1039499)), and neither is coaches' Messages link (`turn-messages-on-for-coaches`), so coaches no longer see the Messages page that went out last week. *Liseidy Bueno*
- **Moderate DMs the way session chat is moderated:** 🧪 students and coaches can report a DM, the way they report recap DMs ([subway !3163](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3163), [high-line !2078](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2078)); 🎁 each DM records whether the student sent it while shadow banned, coaches don't receive those, and coaches can't message a shadow-banned student, seeing a tooltip that the student can't receive DMs ([subway !3167](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3167), [subway !3178](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3178)); 👀 subway refuses a coach's DM to a shadow-banned student too, even one shadow banned mid-conversation ([subway !3181](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3181)); 👀 the coaches' tooltip for it, which doesn't say why ([high-line !2091](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2091)). Rolled out to no one yet ([`direct-messages`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1039499)). *Trey Stevens, Liseidy Bueno*
- **Favorite a coach from My Coaches, and see more of them there:** 🧪 the star, the coach's status, and a Request session button in the DM panel, filled even when the coach is offline ([high-line !2070](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2070)); 🧪 a hover card on the avatar with what the coach chose to share, and the coach's name opening the DM ([high-line !2068](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2068)). Rolled out to no one yet: the DM panel waits on DMs, and the hover card on [`show-volunteer-opt-in-to-share-info`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/823424). *Liseidy Bueno*
- **Show whether each coach is online, in a session, or offline, for the My Coaches redesign:** 🧪 a dot and label on each coach's card ([high-line !2054](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2054)); 👀 coaches choose whether students see it, as one more item in what they share, and students see it only when the coach turns it on ([subway !3185](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3185), [subway !3187](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3187), [high-line !2103](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2103)). Rolled out to no one yet ([`show-coach-status`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1039508)). *Liseidy Bueno*
- 🧪 **Let a student request a specific coach, from My Coaches too:** the request button on each coach's card, restyled to match the design. Reaches 60% of students with at least one session ([`student-request-specific-volunteer-sessions`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/713196)). ([high-line !2064](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2064)) *Liseidy Bueno*

## Coach queue

Revise the request dispatch algorithm to offer a new session to a few coaches one at a time, the way a library hold list runs down, before it goes to every coach online. Earlier digests called this Session holds.

- 🚀 **Redesign the session list coaches pick requests from, which the queue will later be built into, and the dashboard banner:** a gear icon for the list's settings menu in place of the caret ([high-line !2075](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2075)); a "Claimed!" badge and a slide-out when a session is picked up or cancelled, or just a fade with reduced motion ([high-line !2069](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2069)); a new dashboard banner in place of the camping header, reading "Every session counts." over how many students are online and how many sessions are going, refreshed every 10 seconds ([high-line !2079](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2079), [subway !3160](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3160)); the student's grade after their name in each row ([high-line !2098](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2098)); request notifications as a solid white card with a dark border instead of a see-through one, stacked three deep with a count of how many more students are waiting ([high-line !2096](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2096)). *Jamie Kasulis, sammy nave*
- **Offer sessions to coaches one at a time, in place of session holds:** 🧪 version 4 of the scorecard: points come faster for time spent waiting for a session and slower for days since the last session, and new tiers give one award by group instead of a rate (a bonus for 2 to 6 sessions, a smaller one for 7 to 13, and a boost for power tutors with 50 or more); a coach who lets an offer expire is marked inactive, and coaches go from passive to inactive after 30 minutes instead of 60 ([subway !3165](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3165)); 🧪 test students' requests are never offered ([subway !3177](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3177)); 🧪 a browser notification with each offer, "We're holding this session for you," closed when the offer alert goes ([high-line !2087](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2087)); 👀 practice sessions are never offered ([subway !3184](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3184)); 👀 the offer alert becomes one of the new request cards ([high-line !2100](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2100)); 👀 only coaches who have joined the queue are scored and offered sessions, scored by their time in the queue instead of time online, and dropped from it after 20 seconds offline or inactive ([subway !3182](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3182)). Since Nov 13 offers reach no students ([`session-offers`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1031506)); on the coach side, half the coaches without a school partner are in the test group, with FWS and America Counts tutors held out ([`session-offers-coach`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1036651)). *sammy nave, Jamie Kasulis*

## NTHS

The National Tutoring Honors Society, where a high school coach founds a chapter at their own school. Moving the president application out of a Google form and into the app, along with the school and chapter records behind it.

- 🚀 **Put Bailey's copy on the Chapter HQ renewal banners.** Renewal dates read "September 30th", and the NTHS red dot shows its reason on hover. ([high-line !2080](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2080)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Keep previously banned students out of Coach mode.** For students on the flag's list, the Coach toggle is hidden, volunteer pages send them to the dashboard, and anyone already in Coach mode is switched back to Student mode when the app loads. The list holds one student so far ([`block-student-coach-mode`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1072235)). ([high-line !2089](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2089)) *Kasozi Wilson*

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- **Build high-line as an Android app in CI:** 🚀 a pipeline that builds the staging app, which talks to the staging backend, and uploads it to Google Play's internal testing track ([high-line !2076](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2076)); 🚀 the Android staging build allowed to fail without failing the pipeline, and unit tests, lint, and HTML validation no longer waiting for it ([high-line !2092](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2092)); 🚀 Android jobs in stages of their own, with an `android-staging` environment to track its deploys in GitLab ([high-line !2093](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2093)); 🎁 the upload reading its Google Play credentials from the right CI variable ([high-line !2102](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2102)). *Alex Lindsay, Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Add ESLint to subway** with one rule on, `use-unknown-in-catch-callback-variable`, so `.catch()` callbacks still logging in the old argument order get caught. ([subway !3046](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3046)) *Alex Lindsay*

### Fixes

- 🚀 **Make error messages stand out again with alert styles.** Bootstrap went a long time ago and nothing replaced its alert styles, so many error messages looked like any other text on the page. The `alert` classes get tinted boxes again, in info, success, warning, and danger colors. ([high-line !2082](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2082)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Send `completedSessions` on students' assignments again.** The dashboard expected it on each assignment and crashed for students with unfinished assignments; high-line already coped with it missing ([high-line !2031](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2031)). ([subway !3107](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3107)) *Alex Lindsay*
- **Upgrade Node to 24.22.3 to patch [a use-after-free bug in Node](https://security.snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-UPSTREAM-NODE-22469231) (CVE-2026-123864):** 🚀 high-line ([high-line !2088](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2088)); 🎁 subway ([subway !3179](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3179)). *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Seed `report_reasons` once, so a fresh local database starts.** Since subway !3150 the test seeds loaded it and `direct_message_reports` twice. The CI seed load now stops on psql errors, so the `test_database` job catches the next one. ([subway !3168](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3168)) *Ben Wheeler*
- ✅ **Allow one survey context per survey, subject, and survey type.** AP Geography had two, so its post-session feedback form showed every answer twice: ten stars, two rows of faces, and two yes/no answers on the safety question. ([subway !3186](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3186)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 👀 **Lift a live media ban from the current partner, not the last one.** Remove Ban cleared the ban on the partner from an earlier session, because the client sent a stale session id. subway works out the caller's current partner itself now, and high-line stops sending the session id. 🐛 [#738](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/738) ([subway !3175](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3175); [high-line !2086](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2086)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 👀 **Run graffiti in local dev and e2e, and point the whiteboard at it.** Local dev and e2e couldn't reach graffiti, so e2e whiteboards ran on the old server. graffiti joins the dev and e2e compose profiles, and the whiteboard reads its server from `VUE_APP_ZWIBBLER_COLLAB_SERVER_ROOT`, which existed but nothing read. ([subway !3171](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3171); [high-line !2084](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2084)) *Chris*

### Internal tools

- 🚀 **Log bans and unbans made in admin as user actions.** A complete ban from admin now writes a `BANNED` action, and lifting it writes a new `UNBANNED` one, alongside the shadow-ban actions already logged. ([subway !3180](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3180)) *Trey Stevens*

### Chores

- 🚀 **Upgraded `firebase-admin` in subway to the latest,** to resolve a [node-forge vulnerability](https://security.snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-JS-NODEFORGE-22113978). ([subway !3164](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3164)) *Alex Lindsay*
